# Security

CS2 IP Changer runs as administrator and its job is to keep your home IP away from game servers, so a leak or a way to abuse its admin rights is a security problem.

Please report these privately through [Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/Sepd0x/cs2-ip-changer/security/advisories/new), not in a public issue. Include the app version (bottom left of the window), what you did and what leaked or what you were able to do.

Only the latest release gets fixes.
